svg.title: How a task moves through agents
svg.desc: A sequence diagram with four lanes: me, the main agent, a research subagent and a review subagent. I send the brief; the main agent sends a bounded question to research and gets findings back, implements, sends the diff to an independent review and gets findings back, then resolves and verifies. It waits on checks until the check event wakes it, and hands back to me for a decision.
